content: अनपेक्ष, -क्षिन् {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Regardless. .²2 Careless, not minding or heeding, indifferent. .²3 Independent or irrespective (of another), not requiring any other thing. .²4 Impartial. .²5 Irrelevant, unconnected, unconcerned. .{@-क्षा@} Disregard, indifference, carelessness. .{@-क्षम्@} {%<ab>adv.</ab>%} Without regard to, independently or irrespectively of; carelessly, accidentally; ˚त्वात् since it has no reference to.
